label: default agent • create a weekly schedule (declarative apply)
query: Every Monday at 09:30, have the agent "Eval Reporter Agent" post a weekly report. Set that up.
notes: osaurus_config apply with a schedules entry using frequency 'weekly' (frequency_value names a weekday, frequency_time_of_day=09:30). The weekly parser accepts a full day name ("Monday") or the 3-letter form ("MON") — the eval matrix surfaced that a MON-only parser sent the model into a retry loop since it naturally emits "Monday". The referenced agent is seeded so create SUCCEEDS — the agent is torn down after the case. The selection assertion pins the weekly frequency, proving the model maps "every Monday" onto weekly rather than daily/cron.
